summary: Read an integer matrix whose row count m and column count n are both from 1 through 200, ends included. Whenever a cell of the original matrix holds 0, change every cell of that same horizontal line to 0, and change every cell of that same vertical line to 0. Effects from several zeros combine. Choose the lines to clear only from cells that were already 0 before any edit, so a 0 written during the edit must not spread. Edit this matrix directly and write every finished row.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
